LESSON: SOIL CONSERVATION

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: AGRICULTURE
Strand: CONSERVATION OF RESOURCES Strand Sub strand Specific learning outcomes Suggested
Topic 1.1: Soil Conservation

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Soil Conservation
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: How can we improve the soil using suitable organic wastes?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. identify sites for soil improvement in the school or community
2. construct organic waste pit for soil improvement

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Soil Conservation

Teach
• Observe Soil Conservation in real life (school compound, home, farm).
• Use safe examples only.
• Name → explain → apply.

Worked example
• Fact 1 about Soil Conservation (in pupil words).
• Fact 2 with a Kenyan example.
• Safe action connected to Soil Conservation.

Try this
• Draw/label one diagram for Soil Conservation.
• Write 5 bullet facts about Soil Conservation.
• Say one safety rule.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• identify sites for soil improvement in the school or community
• construct organic waste pit for soil improvement

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. List 8 facts on Soil Conservation.
2. Teach a friend using only bullet points.

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Revision sheet for Soil Conservation: meaning, diagram, 5 practice questions.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How can we improve the soil using suitable organic wastes?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• identify sites for soil improvement in the school or community
• construct organic waste pit for soil improvement

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
